name: heldout-healthy
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "support.va"
XD (vin enable vout) measurement_dut tau=1.7e-08 positive=8e+06 negative=5e+06 gain=0.97
XM (vin enable launch vout gain slew_metric settle valid status direction) stimulus_meter
tran tran stop=1.4u maxstep=100p
save vin enable launch vout gain slew_metric settle valid status direction
